metas.name: A Love So Beautiful (Areumdawossdeon Wooriegye)
metas.description: Folder: Korean

metas.name: Absolute Value of Romance
metas.description: High schooler Yeo Eui-ju secretly writes web novels by night. When four charming new teachers arrive, they inspire her stories and shake up her school.

metas.name: Agent from Above
metas.description: Bound by a deity's pact, Han Chieh fights demons on Earth. When he uncovers an old enemy's plan for a second invasion, he must fight to save humanity.

metas.name: Boyfriend on Demand
metas.description: Seo Mi-rae is worn out by work. Love? It's the last thing on her mind. But a virtual dating service sparks feelings — and maybe a real shot at romance.

metas.name: Can This Love Be Translated
metas.description: The emotions of a celebrity and her interpreter get lost in translation as they travel the world filming a TV show. Will love find its own language?

metas.name: Dead End Job
metas.description: Drowning in debt, a young man takes lucrative part-time jobs from a mysterious agency — only to find his hustle for more money turning nightmarish.

metas.name: Did Someone Happen to Mention Me
metas.description: Once Japan's most renowned actor, Gen is suddenly forgotten. Fueled by a need for recognition, he claws his way back from zero in this comedy.

metas.name: Doctor X: Mafia in White
metas.description: In a hospital dominated by ego and corruption, an enigmatic but brilliant surgeon arrives — taking on seemingly impossible cases amid fierce opposition.

metas.name: Gold land
metas.description: A young woman working as an airport security agent accidentally comes into possession of a smuggling ring’s gold bars. Caught in a chaotic whirlwind of greed and betrayal among various parties vying for the gold, she becomes consumed by the desire to claim it all for herself.

metas.name: Human Vapor
metas.description: A death on live TV. A culprit who turns to gas. Behind it, a secret project that used and discarded the vulnerable. One detective pursues the dark truth.

metas.name: If Wishes Could Kill
metas.description: A mysterious app promises wishes — then starts a countdown to death. As a group of teens becomes entangled, they must break the deadly chain to survive.

metas.name: Mad Concrete Dreams
metas.description: A debt-ridden building owner agrees to stage a fake kidnapping to save his family and property, only for the plan to spiral into a real abduction and a dangerously escalating situation.

metas.name: Mousetrap
metas.description: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."

metas.name: My Bias, My Boss
metas.description: A dedicated fangirl lands a job at a fashion company, only to discover it was co-founded by her ultimate idol. Determined to remain professional, she hides her identity, but is quickly thrown off course by the company's workaholic CEO. As secret unrequited feelings and hidden personal struggles entangle the trio, she finds herself torn between her lifelong obsession and an unexpected new connection.

metas.name: Our Sticky Love
metas.description: An ambitious prosecutor loses her memory and moves in with a boxing coach who claims to be her boyfriend. Can this sticky situation turn into real love?

metas.name: Our Universe
metas.description: Two in-laws forced to raise their orphaned nephew together slowly overcome their misunderstandings, finding personal growth and an unexpected romance through co-parenting under one roof.

metas.name: Perfect Crown
metas.description: In 21st-century Korea under a constitutional monarchy, a chaebol heiress with everything but status tries to take control of her future after crossing paths with a lonely prince with nothing but his title. Together, bound by a contract marriage, they begin a class-defying romance to rewrite destiny.

metas.name: Phantom Lawyer
metas.description: A timid lawyer who suddenly gains the ability to see ghosts teams up with a cold, elite attorney, and together they take on supernatural clients whose unfinished business reveals buried truths.

metas.name: Reborn Rookie
metas.description: After a powerful conglomerate chairman is betrayed by his children and wakes up in the body of a young soccer player, he uses his business genius and athletic physique to seek ultimate revenge against his family.

metas.name: Sins of Kujo
metas.description: From thugs to yakuza, Taiza Kujo wields the law to defend society's worst. Fellow lawyer, Karasuma doubts his ethics but joins him in facing the abyss.

metas.name: Spooky in Love
metas.description: When a ghost-seeing heir and an ace prosecutor learn that a single touch makes them a strangely effective duo, they team up to crack unsolved murders.

metas.name: Spring Fever
metas.description: After moving to a quiet rural town to heal from past heartbreak, a withdrawn teacher slowly rediscovers warmth and joy through her unexpected connection with a rough-around-the-edges but kindhearted local man.

metas.name: Straight to Hell
metas.description: As Japan's most famous fortune teller, Kazuko Hosoki ruled TV and bestseller lists, but who was she behind rumors of spiritual scams and underworld ties?

metas.name: Take Charge of My Heart
metas.description: A corporate heir with an artificial heart meets a woman who's literally electric. They strike a deal that makes his heart beat — in more ways than one.

metas.name: Teach You a Lesson
metas.description: An inspector from the Educational Rights Protection Bureau (ERPB) who is authorized by the government to use physical intervention and unconventional methods to discipline delinquent students and reform the educational system.

metas.name: The Apartment Job
metas.description: Desperate for cash, a former gang boss teams up with an aspiring lawyer to steal an apartment complex's reserve fund — only to uncover deep corruption.

metas.name: The Art of Sarah
metas.description: A body found in the middle of town. A luxe label on the rise. A detective tests every stitch of a woman's story that keeps changing. What really happened?

metas.name: The Blue Road
metas.description: Two detectives join forces when brutal murders and cryptic messages surface across borders — but the deadly truth lurks dangerously close.

metas.name: The East Palace
metas.description: A man who walks the spirit world and a court lady who hears the dead enter the East Palace by the king's orders — can they unravel its dark secrets?

metas.name: The Fixers
metas.description: A washed-up gangster reluctantly teams up with an arrogant political heir to become "fixers", cleaning up dangerous secrets for both sides of the law.

metas.name: The Judge Returns
metas.description: The return of corrupt judge Lee Han-young, who was a slave to a large law firm, to the past 10 years ago. He makes new choices to punish evil and implement justice.

metas.name: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier
metas.description: A plastic-spoon man is on his way to becoming a legendary army cook—uncovering dark secrets within the base through his cooking skills.

metas.name: The Scandal
metas.description: In Joseon, a secret proposal ignites hidden desires in a gifted noblewoman, a famed lover and an unsuspecting lady caught in their dangerous game.

metas.name: The Scarecrow
metas.description: A fiercely competitive police officer and an idealistic prosecutor, former high school classmates, reunite while investigating a nationwide serial murder case, pulling them into both a dangerous pursuit and an unresolved personal past.

metas.name: the Wonderfools
metas.description: A goofy group of townies stumbles into superpowers and fights rising evil as doomsday panic grows in this wild, turn-of-the-century action comedy.

metas.name: Unconditional
metas.description: A mother-daughter vacation abroad takes a devastating turn when Gali is arrested for drug possession. Refusing to accept the charges, her mother Orna risks everything on a quest for freedom—only to get entangled in a web of Gali's secrets.

metas.name: Viral Hit
metas.description: A bullied high schooler becomes an overnight sensation after a viral video. But when his newfound fame turns sour, he must learn to fight for himself.

metas.name: We Are All Trying Here
metas.description: An aspiring director hits rock bottom after 20 years chasing his debut — until he meets an overwhelmed producer who helps him rediscover his self-worth.

metas.name: Aema
metas.description: In 1980s Korea, a movie star and a starlet defy male-dominated industry rules and backstage corruption while filming the provocative "Madame Aema."

metas.name: As You Stood By
metas.description: When two women plot to end an abusive marriage through murder, an unexpected visitor arrives — threatening to shatter everything they've carefully planned.

metas.name: Beyond the Bar
metas.description: A young, rookie lawyer with a strong sense of justice joins a top law firm — navigating the complex legal world under a cold, demanding mentor.

metas.name: Confidence Queen
metas.description: Three con artists with different backgrounds, team up for a daring and adventurous scheme of revenge against the villains of this era.

metas.name: Genie Make a Wish
metas.description: After a thousand years, a quirky genie returns to grant wishes to a woman born without feelings. Can his magic bring love and wonder to her world?

metas.name: Good Boy
metas.description: Olympic medalists join the police force through a special recruitment program, trading medals for badges as they tackle violent crimes and injustices with their athletic skills.

metas.name: Had I Not Seen the Sun
metas.description: Filmmaker Zhou Pin-yu interviews a serial killer in prison — an encounter that triggers a string of mysterious events tied to a buried past.

metas.name: Happiness Thailand
metas.description: Folder: Korean

metas.name: Last Samurai Standing
metas.description: In the early Meiji era, Shujiro, once known as an undefeated samurai, decides to participate in a deadly survival game to save his family and villagers.

metas.name: Love Scout
metas.description: Yoo Eun-ho, a single dad armed with perfection, becomes the secretary of Kang Ji-yun, the CEO of a popular headhunter company, who doesn't do anything except work.

metas.name: Mad Unicorn
metas.description: An aspiring entrepreneur breaks new ground with the launch of a startup courier service that brings new opportunities — and powerful enemies.

metas.name: Melo Movie
metas.description: A movie buff falls for an aspiring director, igniting a romance that fizzles out too soon. When their paths cross again, can love find its way back?

metas.name: Mercy For None
metas.description: After severing ties with his gang, a former gangster returns to uncover the truth behind his brother's death — embarking on a relentless path of revenge.

metas.name: Miss King
metas.description: The daughter of a genius shogi player channels the pain of her father's abandonment and her mother's death to become an elite competitor.

metas.name: Newtopia 2025
metas.description: Jae-yoon, a late military enlistee, and his girlfriend, Young-joo, break up over the phone over growing misunderstandings. But a zombie outbreak rocks the world. A national emergency is declared, a plane crashes in the city center, and Jae-yoon and his unit get trapped on top of a Seoul skyscraper. Young-joo risks the zombie-filled streets to find him. Can their love survive the apocalypse?

metas.name: Oh My Ghost Clients
metas.description: No Mu-jin is a labor attorney who happens to see ghosts. After coming back from the brink of death, he begins solving labor problems requested by ghosts.

metas.name: One High School Heroes
metas.description: A former model student, pushed by domestic abuse and bullying, joins a group that stands up to school violence and defends its victims.

metas.name: Romantics Anonymous
metas.description: A brilliant chocolatier who's afraid of making eye contact meets an heir who can't touch others — but somehow, they're immune to each other.

metas.name: S Line
metas.description: A young woman with the ability to see mysterious red connections between lovers discovers her secret gift is no longer unique when special glasses granting similar powers appear on the black market.

metas.name: Study Group
metas.description: A struggling student at Korea's worst high school forms a study group while protecting his classmates with his fighting skills, hoping to overcome academic challenges and secure a spot in college.

metas.name: Tastefully Yours
metas.description: Driven to claim top culinary honors, an arrogant heir meets a low-profile but stubborn chef whose recipes astonish him — sparking an unlikely romance.

metas.name: Tempest
metas.description: Seo Munju, a highly accomplished diplomat and former ambassador to the United Nations, and Sanho, an international special agent shrouded in a veil of secrets, race to uncover the truth behind an attack that threatens the future stability of the Korean peninsula.

metas.name: The Defects
metas.description: An action thriller depicting the revenge of children who barely survived the brink of death after being abandoned by their adoptive parents.

metas.name: The Divorce Insurance
metas.description: No Ki-jun, an employee at an insurance company, decides to develop a divorce insurance policy after personally experiencing three divorces that impacted his life and finances. Despite potential biases, he believes divorce is an unforeseen disaster and establishes a team for divorce insurance.

metas.name: The First Frost
metas.description: Wen Yifan, by chance, ends up living with her high school classmate Sang Yan, whom she once rejected. They keep their distance until Wen Yifan learns from Sang Yan that she sleepwalks, intertwining their lives once more.

metas.name: The Manipulated
metas.description: Taejoong's life is torn apart when he's framed for a heinous crime and imprisoned. Discovering it was all orchestrated by someone on the outside, he embarks on a rage-fueled quest for revenge.

metas.name: The Price of Confession
metas.description: Accused of killing her husband, a woman is offered a way out by a mysterious stranger: in exchange for a confession in her place, she must commit murder.

metas.name: The Trauma Code Heroes on Call
metas.description: To create a top-tier trauma center, a war-seasoned doctor arrives — bringing his blunt but skilled ways to transform his team into life-saving mavericks.

metas.name: Trigger 2025
metas.description: As illegal firearms flood into a gun-free South Korea, a resolute cop and a mysterious partner join forces to stop the chaos from sweeping the nation.

metas.name: Typhoon Family
metas.description: Depicts the struggles of small and medium-sized businesses and their families who face the 1997 IMF crisis head-on.

metas.name: Undercover High School
metas.description: Ace NIS agent Jung Hae-seong is demoted after a mission failure. He goes undercover at a high school to locate King Gojong's missing gold, meeting his teacher Oh Soo-ah, who sees him as her lost first love, stirring old heartbreak.

metas.name: Unmasked 2025
metas.description: In modern-day Seoul, a crack team of investigative journalists fight for their careers after broadcasting a controversial story. With time running out, the team are given an impossible task if they want to save their jobs – solve a twenty-year-old cold case involving a famous actor who disappeared without a trace.

metas.name: Walking on Thin Ice
metas.description: Eun-soo is a housewife, who struggles to pay for her husband's medical expenses. He is terminally ill. Eun-soo becomes entangled in a bag of drugs with a teacher named Yi-kyeong. He is a mysterious figure. Eun-soo and Yi-kyeong are chased by veteran detective Tae-gu.

metas.name: When Life Gives You Tangerines
metas.description: In Jeju, a spirited girl and a steadfast boy's island story blossoms into a lifelong tale of setbacks and triumphs — proving love endures across time.

metas.name: When the Stars Gossip
metas.description: From two different worlds and with separate missions, an astronaut and a space tourist entangle in space — only to start falling for each other.

metas.name: Would You Marry Me
metas.description: A couple who pretend to be newlyweds, find themselves developing genuine feelings for each other as they navigate their fake marriage.

metas.name: A Shop for Killers
metas.description: A niece who lost her parents and grew up in the hands of an uncle who runs a shopping mall faces a new truth after her uncle's sudden death.

metas.name: Flex x Cop
metas.description: A chaebol cop joins forces with a gritty detective to take down criminals with a touch of wealth and a whole lot of wit.

metas.name: Goodbye Earth
metas.description: As an asteroid hurtles towards Earth with nothing to stop it, one determined teacher fights to keep her former students safe — no matter the cost.

metas.name: Hierarchy
metas.description: The top 0.01% of students control law and order at Jooshin High School, but a secretive transfer student chips a crack in their indomitable world.

metas.name: High School Return of a Gangster
metas.description: A spirit of a middle school dropout gangster who accidentally possesses an 18-year-old boy’s body who killed himself, goes back to high school to take a revenge against the bullies with his gangster skills and encounters unexpected relationship.

metas.name: House of Ninjas
metas.description: Years after retiring from their formidable ninja lives, a dysfunctional family must return to shadowy missions to counteract a string of looming threats.

metas.name: Let's Get Grabbed by the Collar
metas.description: Folder: Korean

metas.name: Light of My Lion
metas.description: The appearance of a mysterious little boy interrupts the quiet, predictable life shared by an artist with autism and his caring older brother.

metas.name: Love Endures
metas.description:
In an aerospace city in the north, seven children who were born an only child became closer than siblings and called themselves "The Big Dipper." They all promised to conquer the college entrance examinations so they can go to Beijing together but seventeen came and went and only Huang Yingzi made it.

"The Big Dipper" was no more as everyone parted ways. Huang Yingzi went to Beijing for school and Jiang Yi left for the States. "Who do you like at the age of seventeen" has become a mystery lingering in the hearts of the seven people. As newcomers in the workplace, they were bruised and battered from the skirmishes between their ideals and reality. Their once pure emotions are like shining stars in the night sky. Huang Yingzi wants to reunite the group only to realize that there a question remains. Meanwhile, Jiang Yi and the others have already been presented their answer.

metas.name: Love Song for Illusion
metas.description: The Crown Prince discovers that his new concubine is actually a vengeful assassin intent on killing the King. But will love intercede – and bring them together?

metas.name: Lovely Runner
metas.description: Right after Ryu Sun-jae, a top star, ends his life, Im Sol, his top fan, somehow ends up at a time when they were in high school and tries to protect him. A fantasy romance unfolds where people who missed each other in time finally meet.

metas.name: Marry My Husband
metas.description: Kang Ji-won, a terminally ill cancer patient, is killed by her husband and best friend after she witnesses them having an affair. She wakes up 10 years before the incident and decides to seek revenge with the help of Yu Ji-hyuk, a director at the company where she works. Now, she must reclaim her fate and eliminate the trash from her life.

metas.name: My Military Valentine
metas.description: After decades of tension, peace has come to the Korean Peninsula. To mark the start of the new North-South Korean peacetime, top South Korean star Lloyd heads to the DMZ to perform a concert, but a misunderstanding forces North Korean special forces soldier Baek Young Ok to step in. Fans capture their interaction and the public mistakes it for a romantic moment. A scandal breaks out, and Lloyd’s fans are outraged. In desperation, he joins the military… only to find himself in a unit led by Young Ok! Could romance bloom between this unlikely pair?

metas.name: My Sweet Mobster
metas.description: Once a convict, Ji-hwan is now a successful, albeit overly cautious CEO, who has yet to experience any of life’s more enjoyable pleasures: namely falling in love. But all that changes when fate brings beloved children’s content creator Eun-ha into his life. The unlikely pair find love most unexpectedly but Eun-ha’s longtime fan, Prosecutor Hyun-woo isn’t ready to let her go without a fight.

metas.name: My Undead Yokai Girlfriend
metas.description: College student Tadashi 'Hachi' Inukai is tired of feeling like a loser. But that all changes one day when he accidentally conducts a mysterious ritual he finds online, summoning a demonic yokai to the mortal plane, nicknamed Izzy. Bonded by magic, Hachi and Izzy must figure out how to navigate life, love and murder.

metas.name: Nevertheless The Shapes of Love
metas.description: After a painful breakup, Miu vows to focus on art and avoid love — until an encounter with an aloof, charming artist stirs her deepest instincts.

metas.name: No Gain No Love
metas.description: Son Hae-yeong seeks out a fake wedding with her neighbourhood convenience store employee, Kim Ji-uk, to avoid missing out on a promotion.

metas.name: Our Love Triangle
metas.description: University student Hae-rin finds herself torn between two men: Woo-jin, a junior she’s developed feelings for, and Eun-hwan, a former crush who returns with memory loss, eager to restart their past relationship. Caught between the past and present, Hae-rin must navigate this complicated love triangle.

metas.name: Parasyte The Grey
metas.description: When unidentified parasites violently take over human hosts and gain power, humanity must rise to combat the growing threat.

metas.name: Pyramid Game
metas.description: Every last Thursday of the month at an all-girls high school, the students of Class 2–5 cast their votes in a popularity poll. The results classify them into Grades A, B, C, D, and F. If they fall into Grade F, they become legitimate victims of school violence.

metas.name: Queen of Divorce
metas.description: Korea’s most skilled divorce solver and an eccentric lawyer who provides solutions for troubled marriages, punishing unfaithful spouses in the process.

metas.name: Queen of Tears
metas.description: The queen of department stores and the prince of supermarkets weather a marital crisis—until love miraculously begins to bloom again.

metas.name: Queen Woo
metas.description: Upon the announcement of the king's death in Goguryeo, a fierce battle ensues among tribes. Queen Woo, who immediately becomes the target of princes and five tribes vying for the throne, struggles to crown a new king within 24 hours. Will Queen Woo be able to transcend the constraints of gender and era to carve out her own destiny?

metas.name: Romance in the House
metas.description: After his business crashes, a man disappears from his family for 11 years. But when he makes a return as their wealthy landlord, a messy reunion ensues.

metas.name: Secret Playlist TV Mini Series 2023
metas.description: Folder: Korean

metas.name: Serendipity's Embrace
metas.description: After 10 years in the US, Hu-young returns to Korea and meets his first love, Hong-ju, at a café by chance. Just as the window into which Peter Pan flew happened to be Wendy's room. Just as the prince happened to find Cinderella's glass shoes. As if nothing had changed in the past 10 years, Hu-young becomes clumsier only in front of Hong-ju. It’s like going back to the age of 19 when he met his first love, Hong-ju. Hu-young and Hong-ju’s days, which have faded a little, begin to turn into vivid rainbow colors again.
